verdict.rationale: Amplitude offers an MCP server and 'Amplitude AI' feature letting users ask plain-language questions to surface analytics answers, and integrates with AI tools like Claude/Cursor, which supports natural-language operation for querying data. However, evidence shows this is limited to querying/insights rather than full product operation (e.g., configuring experiments, flags, dashboards) via natural language, so core admin/config tasks still require the standard UI.
